title: Vantro Trading: operational update on Orvan cargoes

facts.subject: Orvan cargoes
facts.statement: Orvan cargoes continue to move by rail and road where sea space is unavailable.

source_ref.text_snippet: Vantro Trading reports that its Orvan cargoes continue to move by rail and road where sea space is unavailable.

facts.subject: Documentation and insurance for rail cargoes
facts.statement: Documentation and insurance for rail cargoes are taking longer than usual.

source_ref.text_snippet: The firm says documentation and insurance for rail cargoes are taking longer than usual.

facts.subject: Rail and road cargoes
facts.statement: Rail and road cargoes are moving, but it does not give volumes or delivery times.

source_ref.text_snippet: It says rail and road cargoes are moving, but it does not give volumes or delivery times.

facts.subject: Rail route
facts.statement: Vantro expects the rail route to remain its main alternative while the sea corridor is closed.

source_ref.text_snippet: Vantro expects the rail route to remain its main alternative while the sea corridor is closed.
